scope: Bounded challenger search outside Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Virginia and Maryland. Searched Ohio, Pennsylvania, New York, Delaware, Arizona, Florida, Washington and Michigan; this is not a 50-state market census.
recommendation: New York deserves a real challenger position: East Ramapo and Rockland BOCES have verified late-October discipline-specific procurements in the same county. NYCPS offers a separate application-based independent-provider channel. Prioritize procurement readiness and an available licensed clinician before selecting any market; an open bid is not a placement or revenue commitment.

districts.name: East Ramapo Central School District
districts.buyer_type: Public school district; public and nonpublic school service assignments
districts.demand_evidence: Official SLP RFP and addendum describe varying assignments from individual part-time sessions to full-time leave replacement; no guaranteed caseload or headcount.
districts.procurement_status: Verified open SLP RFP-ER-5-27, with Addendum 1 reviewed. A separate PT procurement is listed but its complete terms were not reviewed.
districts.deadline: October 30, 2026, 12:00 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time (America/New_York); questions October 27, 2026, 12:00 p.m. EDT. RFP calls this local time; recheck subsequent addenda.
districts.entry_route: Electronic BidNet submission; RFP describes a free Limited registration option. No registration or submission performed.
districts.incumbents: Not established. Addendum directs incumbent-rate requests to district records/BoardDocs; no such request was sent.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Qualified SLPs with required credentials and IEP experience; individual clinician resumes and references at submission. Leadership credentials alone do not suffice. Required proposal documents, including requested NY business-registration evidence, must accompany the bid. Later clinician additions are possible after contract establishment.
districts.pilot_fit: Strong operational fit for one to three in-person therapists if named qualified clinicians and compliant business infrastructure are already available. The short deadline makes this a readiness test, not justification to rush formation or promise capacity.
districts.supply_economics: No local therapist availability, awarded bill rates, or margin verified. Fiscal-monitor oversight merits contract/payment diligence; the Comptroller's 2025 district record is No Designation, not fiscal stress. Do not import the Town of Ramapo rating.
districts.modality: In-person only; virtual-only and teletherapy rejected in Addendum 1.
critical_gaps: Available named clinicians, pay expectations and school credentials
Current award rates, payment timing and approval route
Clarification of inconsistent renewal wording in the RFP, which refers to a physical therapist and conflicting extension counts
All subsequent addenda before any response
districts.recommendation: Priority challenger for an immediately ready local SLP team; score separately from long-term market attractiveness. A candidate pipeline and procurement approval remain prerequisites.
districts.discipline_only_bid: Yes: reviewed RFP-ER-5-27 is SLP-specific; separate PT procurement listed. Addendum explicitly permits part-time individual sessions as assignments, but no minimum purchase or permission to ignore required proposal components.
districts.insurance_summary: RFP PDF page 5: general liability $1m occurrence/$2m aggregates; professional E&O $2m occurrence/$2m aggregate with two-year continuation; statutory workers compensation and NY disability. Later sample requirements also list $1m excess and $1m auto, and optional bond language. Obtain insurer/buyer clarification of applicable samples; this is not a complete coverage checklist.
districts.experience_distinction: Addendum asks for individual proposed clinician resumes/references, not merely company leadership history; base RFP separately requires organizational administrative/fiscal capability and a satisfactory performance record. No explicit minimum firm age found in reviewed text.

districts.name: Rockland BOCES and component-district programs
districts.demand_evidence: SLP RFP anticipates variable student-service needs; no minimum volume stated.
districts.procurement_status: Verified open separate SLP, OT and PT RFPs; SLP specification reviewed in depth.
districts.deadline: October 29, 2026, 11:00 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time (America/New_York). SLP timeline anticipates November board approval and December 2026 effective award; recheck subsequent addenda.
districts.entry_route: Two sealed proposal copies by mail or hand delivery to Purchasing, 65 Parrott Road, Building 4, West Nyack. Questions through the named purchasing agent only.
districts.incumbents: Not verified from primary award records.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Organizations or individuals may respond. SLP specification calls for NY licensure, NYSED fingerprint clearance, school/disability experience, IEP Direct and Kinney knowledge, transportation, coursework certificates and insurance. District experience and references influence selection; subcontracting requires prior written consent.
districts.pilot_fit: Potential single-discipline entry with adjacent East Ramapo opportunity. One to three clinicians is a proposed limit, not buyer-confirmed volume.
districts.supply_economics: Bidders quote session lengths, evaluation/meeting and mileage charges; no awarded rate or margin established. Multi-site travel and same-day documentation affect utilization.
districts.modality: School programs during school hours, potentially multiple locations; remote delivery not established.
critical_gaps: Therapist supply and fully loaded delivery cost
Full OT/PT specifications if selected instead of SLP
Clinical supervision and approval of any staffing/subcontracting structure
districts.recommendation: Second verified NY procurement option; credible for an experienced licensed clinician-led entrant, with reference and insurance burden recognized.
districts.discipline_only_bid: Yes: speech, OT and PT have separate RFP numbers; only speech terms were reviewed in detail. Scope and qualification review must be repeated before an OT/PT response.
districts.insurance_summary: RFP PDF page 7: general liability $1m occurrence/$2m aggregate, $1m sexual misconduct/assault, $1m auto, $2m E&O occurrence/aggregate with three-year continuation, $3m umbrella/excess, and statutory workers compensation/NY disability. Independent-contractor coverage must be demonstrated. Full endorsements/exclusions/forms must be reviewed.
districts.experience_distinction: School experience is a clinician requirement; bidder must list current/former school clients and years. Selection weighs individual/organization experience and NY school/BOCES years. No explicit minimum firm age found, but a new company is not exempt from evidence requests.

districts.name: New York City Public Schools — independent related-services registry
districts.buyer_type: District-authorized family RSA voucher channel; distinct from a district staffing RFP
districts.demand_evidence: Official guidance provides an independent-provider fallback where employee and contracted-agency services are unavailable. This establishes a channel, not verified unfilled referrals.
districts.procurement_status: Current official independent-provider application available; no fixed submission deadline stated. Qualification/registry route, not an awarded services order.
districts.deadline: No fixed application deadline identified in current July 2026 form
districts.entry_route: Agency or individual provider application, selecting service/borough/school-age or preschool coverage; individual clinician qualification and DOE clearance required before service.
districts.incumbents: NYCPS staff and contracted agencies have earlier positions in the service-delivery sequence; current agency award roster not researched.
districts.new_entrant_requirements: Application requires NYSED licensure/current registration for therapy disciplines, DOE fingerprint/clearance process, and SLP TSHH or TSSLD certification. Agencies list each clinician. Registry standard-rate acceptance and application contact details require confirmation before submission.
districts.pilot_fit: Possible one-borough, one-discipline, small-team pilot without an imminent districtwide tender, if the business accepts family-voucher matching and session-based operations.
districts.supply_economics: Published provider reimbursement: OT/PT/individual monolingual speech $54 per 30 minutes; individual bilingual speech $64.80. These are not wages, guaranteed hourly revenue, or margins. Separate group rates apply. Model travel, no-shows, documentation, billing and payment timing.
districts.modality: Not established from the reviewed application and rate documents; do not assume teletherapy eligibility.
critical_gaps: Actual authorized referrals and parent acquisition process
Local clinician supply, school credentials and availability
Session documentation, invoice rejection and cash-collection behavior
Resolve inconsistent application contact-email variants before submission
districts.recommendation: Best verified no-fixed-deadline alternative, but choose it deliberately as an RSA service model rather than treating it as equivalent to district staffing.

research_limits: No outreach, procurement registration, account login, bid, FOIL request or clinician recruitment performed.
Open solicitations and registry eligibility do not establish guaranteed volume or an available workforce.
No comparable local wage/availability or fully loaded margin study completed; do not rank New York highest on economics from this work alone.
Exact public procurement requirements are evidence for the named opportunity, not a substitute for state-wide legal/credential review.
